name: security-buildkite-agent-hooks-review
intent: Buildkite agent hooks, dynamic pipelines and secret-bearing execution
artifacts: Pipeline upload authority, agent queues/hooks/plugins, environment injection and workspace lifecycle.
trace: Trace editable dynamic steps or repository hooks into an agent with protected credentials or persistent state.
experiment: Use a local/isolated agent fixture with a synthetic secret and inert hook; compare trusted queue/job and lower-trust uploaded step.
disproof: A queue name or dynamic pipeline capability is not a defect without a violated trust boundary.
repair: Separate agent queues/trust and constrain hooks/plugins/secrets, verifying cleanup and approved dynamic workflows.
branch_decisions: Identify which hooks come from agent configuration, plugins or the checked repository and when each runs relative to secret injection and checkout. Dynamic pipeline upload can delegate new steps; inspect who supplies those steps and queue/agent selection. A trusted agent administrator altering a hook is not an untrusted repository escape.
